standards.title: 16 CFR Part 23 — FTC Guides for the Jewelry, Precious Metals, and Pewter Industries
standards.quote: Displaying title 16, up to date as of 11/09/2026. Title 16 was last amended 10/30/2026. … § 23.3 Misrepresentation as to gold content. (a) It is unfair or deceptive to misrepresent the presence of gold or gold alloy in an industry product, or the quantity or karat fineness of gold or gold alloy contained in the product, or the karat fineness, thickness, weight ratio, or manner of application of any gold or gold alloy plating, covering, or coating on any surface of an industry product or part thereof.

standards.title: 16 CFR 23.3(b)(6) — gold filled / rolled gold plate / gold overlay terms
standards.quote: Use of the terms "Gold Filled," "Rolled Gold Plate," "Rolled Gold Plated," "Gold Overlay," or any abbreviation to describe all or part of an industry product unless such product or part contains a surface-plating of gold alloy applied by a mechanical process and of such thickness and extent of surface coverage that reasonable durability is assured, and unless the term is immediately preceded by a correct designation of the karat fineness of the alloy that is of at least equal conspicuousness as the term used.

standards.title: 15 U.S.C. § 295 — National Gold and Silver Stamping Act tolerance
standards.quote: the actual fineness of such gold or alloy shall not be less by more than three one-thousandth parts than the fineness indicated by the mark stamped, branded, engraved, or printed upon any part of such article

standards.title: NIST Handbook 130 § 2.17 Precious Metals — troy ounce = 31.103 476 8 g
standards.quote: 1 troy ounce | 1 | 20 | 480 | 31.103 476 8 | 31 103.476 8 … if an item is marked 24 k it is made of 99.9 % pure gold, an item marked 18 k is made of 75 % gold and an item marked 12 k is made of 50 % gold.

standards.title: GIA Gems & Gemology, Spring 2024 — Electroformed Gold Bracelet
standards.quote: The bracelet had a 14K hallmark, which appeared to be stamped or engraved onto a different metal piece that was glued or otherwise adhered to the bracelet … Thick plating and electroforming may not be detected by XRF methods alone, and additional testing may be necessary to detect the application of these processes.

standards.title: GIA Gems & Gemology, Summer 2025 — Gold-Plated Gold
standards.quote: coating 10K gold with a precise amount of gold plating can alter the XRF results, identifying the alloy as 14K or 18K gold without detecting any of the plating … This method is unreliable, however, when a piece of metal is coated with the same element; therefore, visual observation under a microscope is essential

standards.title: CFPB — How do I dispute a charge on my credit card bill?
standards.quote: To protect your rights you must also send a written billing error notice to the card company within 60 calendar days after the charge appeared on your statement. … last reviewed: APR 15, 2024

standards.title: FTC Consumer Advice — Buying Platinum, Gold, and Silver Jewelry
standards.quote: Near the karat quality mark, look for the name or the U.S. registered trademark of the company that will stand behind the mark. … If you're thinking about buying a piece of gold jewelry but don't see a trademark along with the karat mark, don't buy it. … The phrase "solid gold" means the gold item isn't hollow.

findings.title: All 23 Ross-Simons canonical prices are sitewide-promo originals; every live PDP now prints a lower sale price

Stored canonical prices equal the ORIGINAL prices and remain reproducible as originals, but the checkout price is the sale price. Handoff: canonical owners should disclose promo-vs-original price basis on data/rings.json rows and flagged.html.

limits: fetch_page reads rendered HTML/JSON; bot walls and JS-only price widgets can hide values — anything unread stays null and is listed as not_published/unverified.
Ross-Simons and Blue Nile live checkout prices include sitewide promos; this audit records BOTH the stored original and the live sale price and never overwrites stored data.
Prices are snapshots at 2026-11-11 fetch time; retail prices move with the gold market — always re-open the official page before buying.
Physical hallmark, maker's mark, and independent XRF/professional testing still require the ring in hand — nothing on any page proves purity (16 CFR 23.3, GIA 2024/2025).
This file corrects nothing in shared datasets; all corrections are REQUESTED in COORDINATION.md §5 for the owning sessions.
